item: Home trending: per-day keyword counts kept in the database (R625, R623)
summary: keyword_day_counts holds SUM(count) per (day, keyword); trending reads it after the DuckDB rollup and before the live scan, exact (stale days read live). No INSERT trigger (R625): days rebuilt whole from ix_mention_date_keyword, the id tail folded by the idle maintenance, AFTER DELETE/UPDATE triggers mark stale days (reuse floor + floor_gen for top ids), full rebuild on an epoch change, a 7-day backstop or a remade trigger. Visible stoppable job keyword-day-counts. 12 M bench, exact every run: six Home sums 4.4 s to 0.12-0.39 s plain, 15 s to 0.25-0.44 s SQLCipher; insert cost unchanged, re-index and keyword-fold writes +0 to +5 %. Release note: Home's rising keywords load in well under a second on large corpora.
